name: City Council Special Community Meeting - Meetup with the Mayor
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

  As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting
  notice is being issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956. 1 Members of the City Council present will not formally
  convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action at the event.

  MEETUP WITH THE MAYOR

  Marie Callender’s
  220 S. Atlantic Blvd, Monterey Park 91754

  Tuesday
  May 12, 2026
  5:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  III.  Adjournment

1 This agenda is being posted in an abundance of caution in accordance with ___ Ops.Cal.Atty.Gen. ___

(April 18, 2024) [Opn. No. 23-102 at 2024 WL 1812958].
minutes_text:
74-209

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Special Community Meeting
  May 12, 2026

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at Marie Callender’s located at 220 S. Atlantic Blvd., Monterey Park, CA, 91754
on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Inez Alvarez called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Jose Sanchez, Elizabeth Yang
  Council Members Absent: Henry Lo, Vinh Ngo, Thomas Wong

  Also Present:
  Director of Community Development Timothy Hou
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Director of Human Resources and Risk Management Christine Tomikawa
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Fire Chief Jason Hing
  Police Chief Scott Wiese
  Economic Development Manager Joseph Torres
  Recreation and Community Services Manager Christina Alatorre
  IT Manager Martin Dinh
  Public Works Manager Xochitl Tipan
  Principal Management Analyst Rebecca Bojorquez
  Code Enforcement Supervisor Rey Lozano
  Administrative Aid Anays Navarro
  Citlali Tejeda City Communications Fellow
  Recreation Leader Samantha Egurvide

  Meet Up with The Mayor

  I. Welcome

  II. Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  Mission Statement
  The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth
  and opportunity, and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
   74-210
  May 12, 2026
III. Adjournment

Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 5:15 p.m. by City
Manager Alvarez

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk
